summary: A great daily either way. Everyone knows these names, and Winnie-the-Pooh, Disney Princess and Anpanman outselling Harry Potter is a real surprise. In Blitz nearly everything a casual player names scores.
reasons: Casual run: Star Wars, Marvel, Harry Potter, Pokemon, Barbie and 'disney' (Disney Princess) found. Lives went on Mario (#42), Batman (#12), Spider-Man (#13), James Bond (#41) and Hello Kitty (#11), all near misses with a lesson. Out of lives on guess 12 with 6/10.
Fan got 10/10 with 2 lives lost, so the curve works. Pokemon, Star Wars and Harry Potter are gimmes, merch giants like Pooh and Mickey take some thought, and Anpanman is the fair stretch.
Top 10 matches the source table. The source page carries an out-of-date warning, and Mario at $9.7B will raise eyebrows. Blitz is excellent: 26 of 28 casual names scored.
fixes: Add aliases from the source's own parentheticals and common names: Middle-earth (#47) 'The Lord of the Rings', 'Lord of the Rings', 'LOTR'; Despicable Me (#32) 'Minions'; The Railway Series (#44) 'Thomas the Tank Engine', 'Thomas'; Ultra Series 'Ultraman'; Sesame Street 'The Muppets', 'Muppets'. All are unrecognized today.
'disney' alone resolves straight to #5 Disney Princess, though #2 Mickey Mouse & Friends is just as much Disney. Make it an ambiguous alias (offer both) or drop it.
